name: Madrigal del Monte (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, yellow at the hoist and fly, red above and blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Madrigal del Monte (a castle, a tree and a chalice).
history: Municipal flag of Madrigal del Monte; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
